patch:
@@ -42,6 +42,35 @@ if [ ! -f "${ROOT}/.container-type" ]; then
   echo "${CONTAINER_TYPE}" > "${ROOT}/.container-type"
 fi
 
+# Check if container type or tag has changed
+NEEDS_CLOBBER=false
+
+if [ -f "${ROOT}/.cache/previous-container-type" ]; then
+  PREVIOUS_CONTAINER_TYPE=$(cat "${ROOT}/.cache/previous-container-type")
+  if [ "${PREVIOUS_CONTAINER_TYPE}" != "${CONTAINER_TYPE}" ]; then
+    echo "Container type changed from ${PREVIOUS_CONTAINER_TYPE} to ${CONTAINER_TYPE}"
+    NEEDS_CLOBBER=true
+  fi
+fi
+
+if [ -f "${ROOT}/.cache/previous-container-tag" ]; then
+  PREVIOUS_CONTAINER_TAG=$(cat "${ROOT}/.cache/previous-container-tag")
+  if [ "${PREVIOUS_CONTAINER_TAG}" != "${CONTAINER_TAG}" ]; then
+    echo "Container tag changed from ${PREVIOUS_CONTAINER_TAG} to ${CONTAINER_TAG}"
+    NEEDS_CLOBBER=true
+  fi
+fi
+
+if [ "${NEEDS_CLOBBER}" = true ]; then
+  echo "Running clobber due to container changes..."
+  ./do clobber
+fi
+
+# Update the cached values
+mkdir -p "${ROOT}/.cache"
+echo "${CONTAINER_TYPE}" > "${ROOT}/.cache/previous-container-type"
+echo "${CONTAINER_TAG}" > "${ROOT}/.cache/previous-container-tag"
+
 echo "Using ${CONTAINER_TYPE} environment"
 
 if [ -v GITHUB_ACTIONS ] && [ "${CONTAINER_TYPE}" == "singularity" ]; then
